nodes.name: CTX | Normalize Form Request
nodes.notes:
Node ID: CTX-006

Purpose:
Normalizes raw manager form submissions into the standard internal request envelope used by the Revenue Intelligence workflow.

Responsibility:
- Reads Requester Name, Requester ID, and Report Question from the form submission.
- Sets channel = form.
- Sets source = form_submission.
- Applies a controlled default requester ID when no requester ID is supplied.
- Preserves the form submission timestamp when available.
- Produces the standard request structure required by CTX-002 and downstream validation.

Security / Governance:
- Accepts business request information only.
- Does not interpret KPI intent, authorize metrics, generate SQL, access PostgreSQL, or select delivery destinations.
- Does not accept or create database credentials, SQL templates, table names, or executable queries.
- All normalized requests continue through the same shared validation and governance controls as other intake channels.

Expected Output:
channel = form
requester_id = submitted value or form_requester_001
requester_name = submitted value or Form Requester
question = submitted Report Question
source = form_submission
environment = development
status = received

nodes.name: INT | Manager Report Form
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
INT-003

NODE NAME
INT | Manager Report Form

NODE TYPE
n8n Form Trigger

PHASE
Phase 7 — Slack / Form / API Delivery
Phase 9 — Security + Audit + Testing

PURPOSE
Provide an authenticated manager-facing form for governed revenue reporting requests.

RESPONSIBILITY
Accept manager identity and natural-language reporting questions.

Require authentication before the production form can be accessed.

Pass authenticated form submissions to the standard REVINT request normalization and governance pipeline.

AUTHORIZED INPUT
Authenticated Form submission containing:
Requester Name
Requester ID
Report Question

AUTHENTICATION CONTRACT
Authentication = Basic Auth

Production exposure at the verified Phase 9 checkpoint is localhost only.

Only callers presenting valid credentials may access and submit the production manager form.

Authentication credentials are stored only in n8n Credentials.

Unauthenticated access must fail before the form becomes available.

If this form is later exposed beyond localhost or through a public domain, tunnel, reverse proxy, or hosted environment, the access boundary must be reviewed again and public transport must use HTTPS.

SECURITY BOUNDARY
Authentication controls access to the form.

Authentication does not grant SQL authority, KPI authority, database authority, or delivery authority.

Every submitted request must still pass:
Request envelope validation
KPI catalogue governance
Approved query validation
Runtime parameter validation
PG | Reporting RO execution
Result validation
Presentation and delivery controls

Credentials, SQL templates, database names, internal audit data, and workflow implementation details must never be exposed through the form.

OUTPUT
Authenticated manager request passed to:
CTX | Normalize Form Request

NO AI
NO SQL
NO DATABASE WRITE
NO REPORTING DATABASE ACCESS
NO CREDENTIAL EXPOSURE

STATUS
Phase 7 verified form intake
Phase 9 Basic Auth access boundary verified
Unauthenticated production-form access blocked
Authenticated end-to-end production Form execution verified

nodes.name: VAL | Form Return Successful?
nodes.notes:
COMPONENT ID
VAL-029

NODE NAME
VAL | Form Return Successful?

NODE TYPE
If

PHASE
Phase 7 — Slack / Form / API Delivery

PURPOSE
Routes the result returned from the core Revenue Intelligence
orchestrator to the correct browser-facing Form Ending page.

RESPONSIBILITY
Checks the bounded form_return_status returned by REVINT-01.

Successful governed results continue to the success Form
Ending page.

Rejected results continue to the safe rejection Form Ending
page.

AUTHORIZED INPUT
form_return
form_return_status

VALIDATION CONTRACT
TRUE:
form_return_status = ready

FALSE:
form_return_status != ready

SECURITY BOUNDARY
The gateway does not inspect internal SQL, audit data,
credentials, AI prompts, or governance internals.

Routing is based only on the bounded return contract produced
by REVINT-01.

OUTPUT
TRUE → DEL-014 success Form Ending
FALSE → DEL-015 safe rejection Form Ending

NO AI
NO SQL
NO DATABASE WRITE
NO EXTERNAL API CALL

STATUS
🟡 In Progress — Form return routing configured and awaiting
genuine end-to-end Form verification.
